cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Lost in the Process
cards.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your parcel got caught between reception and dispatch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left it on the bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Dispatch handed it to transport without a receipt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Both departments are you. Call the bus company.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll report a failure across dispatch, transport and receipt control. They'll need to investigate all three.

mechanism: A corrects a personal accusation into a multi-stage incident account, using expert process language to hide having left a parcel on a bus.
confusable: D182 excludes questions from scope; D181 distributes the actual cause across steps instead of answering for one person.
comparison: A useful bus-company call differs from correcting an invitation mailing workflow.
seedUse: Keep B identifying A as both departments and requesting a call; A should act while still classifying responsibility away.
